notes.title: Rail Recon is available NOW!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce the release of Rail Recon. Hopefully, you will enjoy it as much as we did while developing the game.


Over more than 7 months we have been working on getting this game out to the world. It’s the first time for us to ship a finished game.
We are looking forward to hearing your feedback.


Thanks to everybody who helped us out to reach this point.
- Triggered Studios
